text: At its meeting on June 18, 2026, the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee considered Item FA8.3 and made recommendations to the Economic and Community Development Committee. Summary of the report (May 21, 2026) from the Chief of Staff to City Manager and General Manager, Economic Development and Culture This report responds to the Economic and Community Development Committee request to report back on the City rejoining the Association francophone des municipalités de l'Ontario. This report recommends that the City join Association francophone des municipalités de l'Ontario as an Individual Member for the remainder of 2026 and 2027. City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the City Manager to register one staff member for Individual Membership for Toronto in the Association francophone des municipalités de l'Ontario (AFMO) for the remainder of 2026 and up to four Individual Memberships for 2027 as follows: a. 1 Member of Council to be appointed by Council on the recommendation of the Striking Committee; b. 1 City staff member to be selected by the City Manager; and c. Up to 2 public members who served as members of the 2022-26 Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee, to be selected by the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture. 2. City Council direct the City Clerk to canvass Members of Council for interest in appointment to the Association francophone des municipalités de l'Ontario (AFMO) for the 2027 calendar year. 3.
